notes: 50,000,000,000 tokens / 1,000,000 = 50,000 units of a million tokens; 50,000 x USD 0.06 = USD 3,000 input-equivalent; 50,000 x USD 0.18 = USD 9,000 output-equivalent. A third-party list circulating on 2026-10-22 states the grant is 1,000,000,000 tokens, which the vendor page contradicts by a factor of 50; the vendor figure is recorded. This is the largest per-entity inference credit found and it is closed to a person without a funded company. It is a separate programme from the signup record above: the same provider carries both a closed grant and a card-gated API.
